exchanges.text: We have agreed to use Redis for the session cache.
Bob: I will configure the session cache monitoring.
We decided that all invoice exports will be CSV files.
Carol: I will write the invoice export guide.
The team has decided to use Grafana for service dashboards.
Dave: I will build the service health dashboard.
We agreed that the support rota will rotate weekly.
Alice: I will publish the support rota.
We have decided to require two reviewers for security changes.
Bob: I will update the security review checklist.
Good morning everyone. PRIVATE_CONTEXT_MARKER
@Jeeves Which database did we choose for the ledger and why?
replies:
Postgres, because transactions are required.

• **[DEC-0138] Use Postgres for the ledger**
  **Decided by:** @Alice | **Date:** 2026-09-16
  **Rationale:** Transactions are required

The related action is **[ACT-0131] Write the ledger migration** — owned by @Bob, currently open.

exchanges.text: @Jeeves Who owns the ledger migration?
replies:
@Bob owns it.

• **[ACT-0131] Write the ledger migration**
  **Owner:** @Bob | **Status:** open

To reassign, use `ACT-0131 reassign to <name>`; to close it, `ACT-0131 done`.
